title: Pension rebalancing, Treasury leg (Harvey, Mazzoleni and Melone 2025): ZN in the last 5 days when equities outperformed bonds month to date
rule: as K3 (Gen143, 5 days): month-to-date ES vs ZN return at day -6; if ES outperformed, LONG ZN (pensions buy bonds), else SHORT ZN; size 0.10 / ZN 60d vol; daily_book costs
